user.title: Set up SmartVan.io
user.description: Connect to your SmartVan.io devices via MQTT. Make sure MQTT is already configured in Home Assistant.

data_description.mqtt_prefix: The MQTT topic prefix used by your SmartVan.io devices. Default is 'smartvanio'. Only change this if you have a custom setup.
data_description.beta_channel: Enable to receive beta firmware updates. Disable for stable releases only.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Configure {name}
bluetooth_confirm.description: A SmartVan.io device was discovered via Bluetooth. Enter your WiFi and MQTT details to provision the device.

data_description.wifi_ssid: The WiFi network the device should connect to
data_description.mqtt_broker: IP address of your MQTT broker

zeroconf_confirm.title: Configure {name}
zeroconf_confirm.description: A SmartVan.io device was found on your network. Enter your MQTT broker details to complete setup.

data_description.mqtt_broker: IP address of your MQTT broker

await_mqtt.title: Waiting for {name}
await_mqtt.description: Credentials were sent to the device. Waiting for it to connect to WiFi and MQTT. This may take up to 60 seconds.

flash_legacy.title: Update {name} before provisioning
flash_legacy.description: Legacy {firmware_type} detected. The current firmware on this device will need to be updated in order to continue working with this version of the integration

progress.flashing: Downloading firmware and pushing to device — do not power off the device.

progress.waiting_for_reboot: Firmware flashed. Waiting for the device to reboot and reconnect to WiFi — this usually takes 20-40 seconds.

error.mqtt_not_available: MQTT integration is not configured. Please set up MQTT first.
error.invalid_prefix: Invalid MQTT prefix. Must not contain /, #, or + characters.
error.ble_write_failed: Failed to send credentials to the device via Bluetooth. Make sure the device is nearby and try again.
error.http_provision_failed: Failed to send MQTT credentials to the device over WiFi. Check that the device is reachable and try again.
error.device_not_responding: The device did not connect to MQTT. Check your WiFi and MQTT credentials and try again.

abort.unknown_firmware_type: Couldn't tell what kind of device {name} is from its hostname, so we can't safely flash it. Reflash it manually with the correct firmware, then add it again.
abort.post_flash_unreachable: Couldn't reach {name} at {host} after the flash completed. The device may have changed IP address. It should appear in Discovered automatically once it broadcasts on mDNS — check back in a minute.

data_description.beta_channel: Enable to receive beta firmware updates. Disable for stable releases only.

flash_legacy.title: Flash legacy device
flash_legacy.description: Found {count} SmartVan.io device(s) on the network. Pick one to push the latest firmware ({channel} channel) — used when a device is still running older firmware that predates the managed OTA pipeline.

data_description.device: The firmware type is auto-detected from the device's mDNS hostname.

progress.flashing: Downloading firmware and pushing to device — do not power off the device.

abort.flash_success: Firmware flashed successfully. The device will reboot and reconnect on its own.
abort.no_legacy_devices_found: No SmartVan.io devices were found on the network via mDNS. Make sure the device is powered on and connected to the same WiFi as Home Assistant.
